name: aibrowse
description: AI 信息浏览器 —— Windows 桌面多标签页浏览器：内置 Chromium，AI 与用户共享同一浏览器会话，可共读网页、自主浏览、管理长期信源并完成多源研究

scripts.package:release-dir: npm run build:release && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:qualification: electron-vite build --mode qualification && pwsh -NoProfile -File native/watch-qualification/build.ps1 -Mode qualification
scripts.build:qualification:diagnostic: electron-vite build --mode qualification-diagnostic && pwsh -NoProfile -File native/watch-qualification/build.ps1 -Mode qualification-diagnostic
scripts.build:qualification:load-diagnostic: electron-vite build --mode qualification-load-diagnostic && pwsh -NoProfile -File native/watch-qualification/build.ps1 -Mode qualification-load-diagnostic
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --composite false && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.web.json --composite false
